subject.title: feat: apply messages.responsePrefix to message tool outbound sends

question: Should `message(action=send)` resolve selected-model `responsePrefix` variables such as provider, model, modelFull, and thinkingLevel, and what attempt context should it use for sends outside the normal reply pipeline?
rationale: Current main intentionally skips unresolved selected-model templates on tool sends to avoid leaking literal placeholders, so an automated fix would choose a runtime contract rather than repair a narrow implementation bug.

options.title: Implement Live-Attempt Parity
options.body: Pass current attempt provider, model, modelFull, and thinkingLevel into visible message-tool sends and keep skipping or diagnosing prefixes only when no live attempt context exists.

options.title: Document Reply-Path-Only Variables
options.body: Treat selected-model templates as unsupported for message-tool sends and update docs/tests so static and identity prefixes are the intended tool-send behavior.

options.title: Fold Into Attribution Design
options.body: Keep the partial fix and decide this alongside broader model-attribution and fallback-approval work before changing message-tool egress again.

recommendation.title: Implement Live-Attempt Parity
recommendation.body: Pass current attempt provider, model, modelFull, and thinkingLevel into visible message-tool sends and keep skipping or diagnosing prefixes only when no live attempt context exists.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame on the active message-tool and reply-prefix code makes this the best available routing candidate for the product-boundary decision.
